citations.claim: The CLI module imports essential libraries for command-line functionality, rich output, and environment configuration
Uses Typer framework for CLI creation with help text and Rich console for formatted output
DuneClient class provides authenticated HTTP client with base URL and API key configuration
Internal _request method handles HTTP communication with error handling and JSON response parsing
Execute command accepts query ID and optional JSON parameters, returning execution information
Status command provides execution state checking with colored output based on query state
Results command retrieves and displays query results in formatted table with row limiting
Run command implements the complete execute-and-wait workflow with polling and timeout handling
Polling loop with status spinner and timeout protection for long-running queries
Cancel command provides execution cancellation functionality
Query command retrieves and displays query metadata including parameters
Raw command allows direct API endpoint access for debugging and advanced usage
Execute query method handles POST request with optional parameters
Get execution status method retrieves query state and queue information
Get execution results method retrieves completed query data
HTTP client configured with Dune API base URL and authentication headers
Factory function integration with centaur_sdk for API key management
Imports Table class from centaur_sdk for rich table formatting
Singleton pattern for client instance management with lazy initialization
Dependencies include httpx for HTTP client, typer for CLI, rich for output, and python-dotenv for configuration
CLI script entry point configured as 'dune' command pointing to cli.py app
Centaur configuration specifies module and secret management for DUNE_API_KEY
Results display uses Rich Table with column formatting and row limiting
Client initialization requires API key and provides helpful error message with setup instructions
